coverage_contract.daily_coverage: derived for every in-scope date×meet from validated complete/zero partition and observed Parquet row counts

preservation_rules: Keep every source occurrence, including exact repeats and same-key conflicts.
Preserve the full source object in both raw_payload_json and typed_fields_json.
Link horse, trainer, and owner IDs by exact official identifier only; never link a jockey by name.
Keep blank, dash, 휴양마, unmatched IDs, and all pass/reason values as raw source values.
Do not promote passFlag, cancellation, exclusion, or first-pass status into a derived result.
Label all imported observations retrospective with pre-race eligibility unverified.
Preserve raw meet and location labels; do not infer a physical Yeongnam venue split.
